personal.name: Nikita Vaishnav

personal.headline: Crafting responsive, high-performance web applications with React.js & modern architectures.

personal.bio: Frontend-focused developer with hands-on experience building responsive web applications using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. Experienced in integrating REST APIs, developing reusable UI components, debugging application issues, and working with Git/GitHub in collaborative development environments. Strong foundation in frontend fundamentals with a focus on writing clean, maintainable code and continuously learning modern React practices.
highlights: Specialized in React.js component architecture, state management & REST API integrations.
Track record of translating complex requirements into responsive, accessible web interfaces.
Pursuing Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Ramdeobaba University (RCOEM).
Hands-on with modern full-stack workflows including Spring Boot, Node.js, and Cloud Fundamentals.

experience.description: Driving frontend development and API integrations across responsive web applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams to build reliable, high-performance digital products.

projects.title: Flight Booking System
projects.summary: Full-stack airline reservation and booking platform with secure authentication, seat selection, and automated booking pipelines.
projects.description: Built a full-stack flight booking application with a responsive React frontend and Spring Boot backend. Developed user-facing screens, integrated REST APIs, implemented JWT-based authentication, and connected frontend workflows with MySQL-backed services.

projects.title: ChatApp — Real-Time Messenger
projects.summary: Real-time chat application with instant WebSocket communication, multi-room chat, and dynamic UI state handling.
projects.description: Developed a responsive real-time chat application using React.js and Node.js with Socket.IO. Created reusable frontend components, implemented real-time messaging, and integrated backend services for chatroom communication.

projects.title: AI in Healthcare — Disease Predictor
projects.summary: Machine learning system predicting potential medical conditions based on structured patient symptom input datasets.
projects.description: Developed a machine learning-based healthcare application that predicts possible diseases based on patient symptoms. Performed data preprocessing, trained and evaluated classification models, and built a system to provide disease predictions from symptom inputs.

projects.title: Student Risk Assessment Dashboard
projects.summary: Interactive analytics dashboard for educational institutions to monitor and prevent student dropout risks.
projects.description: Developed a responsive dashboard interface for a student dropout prediction system using React. Implemented data upload workflows, configuration screens, student information cards, and visualizations for presenting prediction results.

projects.title: Lost & Found Community Portal
projects.summary: Community portal enabling users to report, search, and claim lost or found items with secure user authentication.
projects.description: Developed a web-based portal using Java, JSP, Servlets, and MySQL with authentication and item-listing functionality. Debugged application issues and improved code organization for maintainability.
